profile.visual_desc: Human sorcerer in layered navy robes and a red face mask. Wears a deep blue turban-style hood and carries a large hook-topped staff. Glowing yellow eyes peer through a mesh visor.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Close-up of a red cloth mask with a dark mesh slit. Intense, glowing yellow eyes shine from the shadows of a heavy blue hood.
profile.weapon_desc: Large wooden staff with a hooked head in the right hand; blue arcane energy channeled through the left palm.
profile.step1_ready: Facing ↘ in a wide stance. Right hand holds the hook staff low; left hand is raised and open in a casting gesture.
profile.step2_windup: Lifts the staff vertically while gathering bright blue energy in the left palm, preparing to cast.
profile.step3_impact: Thrusts the left hand forward, launching a glowing light-blue energy ring toward the bottom-right target area.
profile.step4_finish: Maintains the forward thrust as the energy ring dissipates; staff remains elevated in the right hand during recovery.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The circular blue energy arc in Frame 4 must travel forward along the vector established by the left hand's reaching motion.

evaluation.diagnosis: Animation replicates DOS reference cues. Wind-up and projectile vectors are consistent; perspective and anatomy remain stable.
